source.name: Natural Earth
source.boundary_note: Natural Earth's sourced China-claims worldview, not an assertion that disputes are resolved or an authoritative/current statement of sovereignty. Arunachal Pradesh (also called South Tibet in the source) is administered by India and claimed by China. The sourced Chinese claim is shown as the outer boundary; the source's FCLASS_CN=Unrecognized de facto/McMahon sector is omitted, not relabeled as a province boundary. Other disputes retain source China-view classifications, falling back to default where no China override is supplied. Land boundaries only: no maritime claims or island/coastal sovereignty outlines are inferred from imagery.
source.classification_policy: Use nonempty FCLASS_CN, otherwise FEATURECLA; omit Unrecognized*; International boundary (verify) -> countries; Map unit/Admin-1 classes -> regions; every other class, including unknown values, -> disputed. Apply the same rule to land, auxiliary claim lines and regional lines. Remove regional line portions inside/on disputed-area polygons assigned to CHN by ADM0_A3_CN but not by ADM0_A3 (excluding polygons explicitly classified as Admin-1); do not draw polygon edges or invent provinces.
source.processing: Resolve China worldview, merge connected parts per feature and clip regional lines before simplification; all LODs use the same pinned 1:10m sources. Round to four decimals and discard collapsed lines. No generated polygon edges.
